author: Bernard Gagnon
attribution: Photo: Bernard Gagnon, CC BY 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:March%C3%A9_Lalla_Achou_01.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Trilingual interpretive panel on a wall in Ksar Beni Isguen (Ghardaia). Only the three title banners (English, French, Arabic, left to right) are transcribed; the long paragraph text under each title and the 'OTD' logo are not part of the label. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Credits to Reda Kerbush / Wikimedia Commons
attribution: Photo: Credits to Reda Kerbush / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:P%C3%A2tissier_a_Batna_(%C3%A9crit_en_tifinagh_et_en_arabe).JPG. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Orange pastry-shop fascia in Batna. Each Arabic line has a Tifinagh (neo-Tifinagh, Berber Academy style glyphs) line under it: 9 glyphs under the name, two words under 'halawiyat wa murattabat'. The Tifinagh lines are NOT transcribed: the glyph-to-Unicode mapping of this letter style is ambiguous and the labeller would have had to guess codepoints; a checker who reads Tifinagh should add them. Garage sign at right and car plates are distractors.
source_title: File:Pâtissier a Batna (écrit en tifinagh et en arabe).JPG

lines.latin: al-Masjid al-Atiq al-Jami' (the old congregational mosque)
Ta'assasa sanat 402 H - 1012 M (founded in 402 AH / 1012 AD)

notes: Marble name plate of the old mosque of Ksar El Atteuf (M'zab valley). Western digits. 'سنة' is drawn with a long kashida (tatweel omitted here); the separator between 'هـ' and 1012 is a short dash/kashida. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

notes: Hand-painted blue enamel plate in Beni Isguen (M'zab), with a left arrow. 'du' is small lowercase between PLACE and MARCHE; no accent on MARCHE.
